title: Tax organizer PDF filled
text: Fills out an accountant's fillable tax organizer PDF from gathered tax forms and prior bookkeeping context, then reports which fields it could not complete correctly.

title: Tax return from open-source solver
text: Collects a year of tax PDFs into a folder, fills open-source tax-solver input templates from them, and runs the solver to produce completed federal return forms.

title: Tax-filing skill matches TurboTax
text: Reads W-2s, 1099s and brokerage forms, downloads blank federal and state forms, fills them in, and matches a commercial tax program's result, then packages the process as a reusable skill.

title: Tax fraud detection over notes
text: Builds a notes-vault workflow that screens tax filings for people falsely claiming expatriate status, flagging 217 suspected cases.

title: Ledger reconciled against bank and email
text: Reconciles a plain-text accounting ledger against a read-only business bank feed and synced email to catch unrecorded items, then advises while business and personal returns are prepared in tax software.

title: Return on IRS fillable forms
text: Prepares a personal tax return on the IRS free fillable forms from the year's tax documents, avoiding commercial filing software.

title: Fifty-page return compared across tools
text: Computes a roughly 50-page personal return from 1099 PDFs into spreadsheets and fills the PDF tax forms, in a side-by-side comparison against two other coding tools.

title: Tax spreadsheets and IRA history
text: Reorganizes years of personal tax spreadsheets into cleaner accountant-style workbooks and reconstructs the history of money moved between IRA custodians, including withdrawals and conversions.

title: Bank transactions matched to Gmail invoices
text: Matches exported bank-transaction CSV rows to invoices found and downloaded from email attachments to prepare tax records, taking about four hours with repeated context resets.

title: PDF receipts attached to invoices
text: Attaches a folder of PDF receipts to accounting-software invoices, works out the VAT, and uploads the results through the accounting API after bank transactions sync automatically.

title: Vendor contract redlines
text: Redlines vendor and counterparty contracts such as an OEM agreement against the usual objections, producing markups that opposing lawyers praised before a human lawyer's final review.

title: German accounting via chat
text: Connects an accounting and tax service for German entrepreneurs to a chat client so invoices can be generated and sent and bank transactions reconciled from one prompt.

title: Invoices from plain language
text: Creates and manages client invoices from a plain-language request, generating PDFs, looking up clients and tracking payments through an invoicing server exposed to the chat client.

title: Invoices sent from chat
text: Sends customer invoices from a chat session through a connected invoicing server instead of opening a separate billing app.

title: Bank statement screenshot to budget
text: Extracts every transaction from an uploaded bank statement screenshot and categorizes them by user-defined merchant rules into an automatically updated budget.

title: Appeals workspace for case documents
text: Analyzes and edits DOCX and PDF case documents for injured workers and legal professionals in a desktop workspace with document-signing integration.

title: Bulk invoice PDF extraction
text: Extracts headers and line items from over a thousand invoice PDFs into CSV by spawning one background worker per file, then merges the results into consolidated tables.

title: VAT invoice refuse-don't-guess gate
text: Guards a VAT-critical invoice workflow with a deterministic gate that refuses rather than guesses, packaged as a plugin with skill, subagent, server and hook on a fictional case.

title: Procurement contract playbook review
text: Checks procurement contracts against a company review playbook and returns findings with verified quotes, requiring a human to accept or reject each high-risk item in a hash-chained audit log.

title: Clause-by-clause contract risk scoring
text: Scores uploaded contracts across eight risk areas, flags missing clauses and internal contradictions between articles, and suggests revisions for lawyers and accountants.

title: Founder-side legal document review
text: Reviews NDAs, SaaS agreements, SAFE notes and term sheets from the founder's side, explains clauses plainly, and writes redline-ready replacement language with a sign or do-not-sign verdict.

title: Immigration petition drafting
text: Organizes over a hundred client documents into an evidence index and drafts O-1A, EB-1A and EB-2 NIW immigration petitions with each claim tied to evidence.

title: Immigration filing narratives
text: Drafts immigration filing narratives, support letters and RFE response outlines strictly from case facts and a firm's templates, plus client status-update emails.

title: Bank statement to books reconciliation
text: Reconciles a bank statement CSV against a books CSV with exact, split and batch matching in a tested script, then explains leftovers and drafts the report.

title: DS-160 visa form copilot
text: Guides completion of the long US DS-160 visa application by reading supporting documents with vision, built in three days at a hackathon for a parent's application.

title: Credit card statement subscription audit
text: Analyzes exported credit card statement CSVs, asks about each recurring charge, and helps cancel unwanted subscriptions, including automating the cancellations in a browser.

title: Small business books for the CPA
text: Balances a small software business's books from bank transactions and payment-processor data, producing income statement, profit and loss and balance sheet for the owner's CPA through a double-entry command-line tool.

title: LLC Schedule C from statements
text: Categorizes a year of bank, PayPal and credit card transactions for a single-member LLC, flags questionable deductions and gaps in recurring subscriptions, and fills Schedule C tax forms.

title: Nightly journaling for sixty clients
text: Journalizes transactions nightly for sixty client companies through an accounting-software API with two-stage classification, saving a solo tax accountant over 24 hours each month.

title: Realtor receipt spreadsheet
text: Reads a realtor's receipt files, extracts the expense details, and organizes them into a spreadsheet according to written instructions.

title: R&D tax credit reclassification
text: Compares past R&D reports and company expenses against an auditor's finding, then drafts an email citing the correct code section that turns a zero credit into about eight thousand dollars.

title: LLC and wage return with PDF overlay
text: Completes federal and state returns for a small LLC plus wage income by collecting forms, then planning, and overlaying text onto flattened PDF forms after direct field filling fails.

title: Corporate return from bank statements
text: Processes a year of bank statements, categorizes every transaction, and prepares a small C-corporation's income statement, balance sheet and tax return in about fifteen minutes.

title: Bank reconciliation across accounts
text: Assigns bank transactions to the right invoices, lists open items, and produces an overview of missing receipts from a folder of financial files.

title: Legal workspace contract plugin
text: Reviews contracts, researches legal questions, and drafts and files documents in a legal workspace through a plugin.

title: Contract renewal deadline sweep
text: Scans an entire contract library for renewal dates, notice windows and action-required obligations, then flags each vendor agreement clause green, yellow or red against standard positions.

title: Self-represented divorce work
text: Handles research and drafting for a self-represented divorce after hired lawyers fell short of expectations.

title: Tax season handoff package
text: Walks through organizing tax documents across multiple sessions for rentals, brokerage 1099s, K-1s and multi-state filings, then exports either an accountant handoff package or a TurboTax import file.

title: Monthly expenses to accountant sheet
text: Collects a month's expense documents from Gmail, files them in a Drive folder with uniform names, and builds an index spreadsheet for the accountant.

title: Japanese household scans renamed
text: Renames freshly scanned Japanese receipts, bills and notices with issuer and yen amount in romaji, and appends medical receipts to a spreadsheet-ready table for expense claims.

title: Receipt folder to expense report
text: Ingests receipts and invoices dropped into an inbox folder, records each in a master CSV, and compiles a monthly expense report workbook.

title: Invoice collection and bank matching
text: Syncs invoices from Gmail, extracts their metadata, and matches bank-statement transactions to them with confidence scores for an agency's bookkeeping.

title: Electronic contract creation and sending
text: Creates electronic contracts from a company's details, applies a signature stamp, and sends the resulting PDF.

title: Traditional Chinese contract review
text: Extracts key terms from Traditional Chinese freelance contracts, flags unfair clauses as red, yellow or green with suggested fixes, and compares counterparty-modified versions against the original.

title: Expense reports in corporate system
text: Reads and writes expense reports, individual expenses, receipts and trips in a corporate expense system, with every write gated behind confirmation.

title: Sheet-based P&L audit
text: Reviews a Google Sheet of business finances with an opinionated profit-and-loss audit and fixes spreadsheet errors across read, fix and audit skills.

title: Bank CSV expenses for VAT
text: Classifies expenses from a bank statement CSV for VAT reporting and fills in the spreadsheet an accountant sends over.

title: Monthly invoices from line items
text: Collects noted line items for each client through the month and generates the invoices at month end.
